text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ha, the Make Debut, huh. Not even worth 
looking at.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna put on an unsightly 
run in a place like this. Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's breeze right through it!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Heh, will it really go that smoothly?

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series isn't soft. You'd best 
prepare for your baptism by fire.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wha—why you little—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tsuzuki Reigning!!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, it's me. It's been a while since the 
Debut Race, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
First is race one—I'm gonna blow right 
past them flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
I'd appreciate it if you didn't 
underestimate me with a "for starters."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
――! Number 5... Ah, so you're the race 
favorite, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like she's pretty tough, that 
Tsuzuku Reigning.

—Tsuzuki Reigning. I was set to clash once 
again with the intellectual Umamusume I'd 
faced in the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm surprised. To think you 
actually remember me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ha, how could I forget? After all—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"There's no other Umamusume as smug and 
crafty as you, after all."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Cunning, you say...? I am simply being 
prudent. And besides—

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: You are reckless. Far too reckless.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The hell did you say...?!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? You are strong. However, 
there is virtually no strategy in your 
running.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Simply believing in yourself and muscling 
through won't cut it in the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Especially—with a field of contenders this 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"A field of heavy hitters? It's just a 
Make Debut, for cryin' out loud."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
However, that's not quite the case. In 
fact, behind the scenes, rumors say this 
about the race.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"It might just become a legendary Debut 
race," they say.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: A legend? I haven't even run yet, have I?

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, you and I aren't the only ones 
considered strong contenders. There are 
others—"

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
By pure chance, a remarkable lineup of 
exceptionally talented Umamusume has 
gathered. Debuts that create this much 
buzz don't come around often.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Do you truly believe Jungle 
Pocket can unleash her usual power among 
this lineup?"

"She hesitated. It was true that Jungle 
Pocket had never raced against such a 
formidable lineup of rivals in an actual 
competition before."
If so, running the way I always have...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No need to worry—partner.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You can rest easy. Because...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Cuz I'm Jungle Pocket, that's why!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheheh, hahaha! Now this is a 
masterpiece.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
With no strategy and only baseless 
confidence, there's no way she could 
deliver a good race.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you shall learn of your own 
ignorance on the track. —Farewell."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, they finally took off. Talking 
whatever trash they wanted.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The one who's gonna be crying in the race 
is you, got it?"
choice_data_list:
Still, Pokke, are you sure you'll be fine 
without a strategy?

Still, Pokke, are you sure you'll be okay 
without a strategy?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we don't need crap like that. Stop 
trembling.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, just watch. You'll understand once 
you see me actually run.
